notes: «- قال ابن بشار الشامي وقال أبو داود أبو عبد الله العسقلاني -» is an editor's gloss of name variants and is left out
«أبيه» is the Companion who reports his own prayer with the Prophet, so he is the last link

fixes.reason: K6I attaches the compiler's name to the shaykh the text names in «حدثنا أبو داود»; the compiler cannot be his own teacher in this chain.

evidence.quote: قالا حدثنا أبو داود، حدثنا شعبة
